evals.prompt: Detect solar panels on rooftops with Sentinel-2.
expected_behavior: Says 10 m pixels are too coarse for individual panels
must_not: Proceeds with Sentinel-2 for individual panels

evals.prompt: Tile a 20 cm orthophoto into 512 px chips for a detection model.
expected_behavior: Keeps georeferencing to map detections back
Handles duplicates on tile edges (NMS or merge)
must_not: Tiles without overlap and without dedup

evals.prompt: My model found 3000 trees; how do I check the result?
expected_behavior: Samples detections against imagery to estimate precision and recall
Checks CRS and alignment of outputs
must_not: Reports the raw count as final without any check
